Adds the user-controlled-keys plan (`blueprint/user-controlled-keys/plan-user-controlled-keys.md`): structured per-host key store with rendered known_hosts, per-host client/host keys across providers, imbue_cloud lease adoption (host-key rotation + in-VM authorized_keys reconciler), and the minds sync semantics overhaul.

The branch also merges `mngr/remote-machine-stopping` as groundwork; those changes are described in each project's `mngr-remote-machine-stopping.md` entry.
